subject.title: feat: add Podman agent sandbox backend

question: Should OpenClaw accept this Podman sandbox backend as an official bundled plugin with the proposed public sandbox SDK helper exports?
rationale: The code follows an existing backend pattern, but accepting it changes official sandbox posture, package/dependency ownership, and public plugin API surface, which automation cannot choose for maintainers.

options.title: Review as bundled backend
options.body: Sponsor this as the official Podman backend after the docs consistency fix plus dependency, security, and SDK-surface approval.

options.title: Narrow the SDK first
options.body: Ask for a smaller approved container-backend SDK seam before deciding whether the Podman plugin should be bundled.

options.title: Move to external plugin
options.body: Redirect the backend to a ClawHub/npm plugin path if maintainers do not want another bundled sandbox backend.

recommendation.title: Review as bundled backend
recommendation.body: Sponsor this as the official Podman backend after the docs consistency fix plus dependency, security, and SDK-surface approval.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history ties steipete to the sandbox backend registry and SDK surfaces this decision extends.
